description: Hand-labelled extraction sample for the GraphRAG extraction-quality check (s05 P4.1). Labels were written by reading each chunk's transcript text in the live corpus (verified 2026-07-26): 'entities' are things the chunk unambiguously talks about that extraction must find; each 'claim_keywords' list is one statement the chunk makes, as keywords that must all appear in a single extracted claim. Labels are must-find, not exhaustive - extraction finding more is expected, which is why the eval reports recall only.

labelled.notes: Speaker says the budget bill is currently sitting with a Senate inquiry committee; names Albanese, Chalmers, Taylor, Hanson; mentions the income tax cuts.
Video intro: fundamental concepts of agentic engineering; ramping up agents with memory and skills. Intro chunks may extract few claims, so only entities are labelled.
5-year growth figures per city (Perth ~100%, Brisbane 95%, Adelaide ~90%); federal budget proposed changes and the 12 May contract date.
